headline: Brazil President Lula Set to Appoint Six Central Bank Directors by Late 2027
summary: Brazilian President Lula can name six of nine central bank directors by the end of 2027, with two seats having remained vacant since January.
why: Central bank board appointments influence monetary policy direction, interest rate decisions, and institutional credibility, which are key variables for fixed income and currency investors.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Appointments to the central bank board shape future monetary policy stance.
